caveats: Thresholds from 1992-2002 with +/-5-day windows incl. edges 1991-12-27..2003-01-05; land cells (NaN) set to 0; sea cells defined as finite on all target days. Dataset sst read as stored (kelvin). The final event (2022-08-10 to 2022-08-31) reaches the end of the target window and may continue beyond it; it is truncated by design. Runtime warnings about all-NaN slices come from land cells only.
